independent_reference.decoder: Explicit software h264; hwaccel none; one decode/output thread; no resize, colour conversion or deinterlacing filter
independent_reference.version: ffmpeg version 8.0.1-3ubuntu2 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
independent_reference.selection: Fixed grid step 32 plus edges. Y/U/V centre bytes and each plane 3x3 neighbourhood must be flat and identical in EVERY one of 180 independently decoded frames. Capture is never used to select points or guess frame identity.
independent_reference.model: Real-valued limited BT709 YCbCr equation, clip after matrix; fixed 2/255 channel rounding allowance. BT601 is a separately reported diagnostic only.
independent_reference.strict_policy_preserved: No threshold/neighbourhood/temporal variation was relaxed after observing zero 720p or three FHD eligible points.

metadata_mechanism.description: Pinned FFmpeg starts coded dimensions at 0. Actual node TRY_FMT normalizes that unspecified small request to SMPTE170M; committing the returned format is an explicit SMPTE170M request. Automatic HD colour follows source discovery only if committed colour_default remains true. Direct DEFAULT commit and normalized TRY-return commit therefore differ.
metadata_mechanism.contract_limit: TRY_FMT must be state-pure and return S_FMT-equivalent normalization. The normalized explicit SMPTE170M input is indistinguishable from a deliberate explicit 601 request. No query-history/equality heuristic, explicit override or driver/runtime fix is implemented.
metadata_mechanism.remaining_fix_question: Which caller/bitstream authority should retain unspecified colour intent through negotiation while preserving deliberate full explicit tuples?

interpretation_limits: FHD FAIL concerns only three source-invariant colour/spatial samples, not full-frame or crop qualification; broad reference coverage is insufficient.
720p has no eligible strict invariants; first-frame-only larger colour differences are diagnostic and are not promoted to a source-bound counterexample.
Capture script pauses onAVStarted and records clock 0.0 before/after RenderCapture; this does not bind the image to a particular source PTS or returned DRM object.
Direct decoded YUYV, complete crop/pixels, per-picture GPU PTS/control identity, physical scanout/A/V and performance remain unverified.
A BT601 diagnostic fit does not identify the decoder, G_FMT/S_FMT, frame-metadata, EGL, GPU or renderer stage as the historical cause.
Original native route/PTS/lifecycle receipts and their historical FAIL/NOT_RUN remain unchanged. #538 stays OPEN; heap-only follow-up remains excluded.
